data.title: 美狄亚 · 柳洞寺厨房的手作料理
data.description: 柳洞寺厨房，她把长袍袖子用襻带扎起、系着围裙做饭，尖耳从垂落的发丝间露出；尝味时专注的神情不像魔女，更像新婚的妻子。

data.promptProse: Medea tastes a spoonful from the small cooking pot, concentrating on its seasoning with navy robe sleeves safely tied back above her linen apron. A pointed ear appears through blue hair; vegetables and an empty serving bowl await on the counter. The medium view follows the orderly temple kitchen behind her. Morning light warms her face and spoon, illuminating pot steam while gentle shadows separate the bowl and vegetable pieces from the work surface.
